summary: Iteration 5 — End-to-end testing of the new PUBLIC Carta Digitale feature (public page + QR panel + visibility toggle + settings + export column). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_public_carta.py with 15 tests, all 15 PASS. Covered: GET /api/settings requires auth (401 unauth), works for admin + staff; PUT /api/settings requires admin (staff -> 403); public GET /api/public/carta returns only visibile!=false wines, NEVER includes prezzo_acquisto or foto_path (verified field-by-field), returns `foto: bool` indicator; GET /api/public/foto/<id> returns 404 for hidden wine, 404 for visible-but-no-foto wine, 404 for nonexistent id; toggling carta_pubblica_attiva=false makes /api/public/carta and /api/public/foto/<id> return 404 with Italian message 'La carta digitale non è al momento disponibile'; hide-then-show wine round-trip; CSV + XLSX exports both contain 'Visibile in carta digitale' column with 'Sì'/'No' values; /api/import/preview correctly accepts the Visibile column with empty-string treated as visible (no mapping errors). Setting restored to carta_pubblica_attiva=true at the end. Frontend: public /carta-digitale loads WITHOUT auth cookies in a fresh browser context — header 'Carta dei Vini', public-search-input, public-chip-all + per-tipologia chips, public-wine-<id> rows, clicking opens public-wine-sheet with public-wine-name='Amaranta', public-wine-price='19,60 €'; sheet HTML contains NO 'acquisto' substring (confirmed via inner_html). Search filters correctly ('Amaranta' -> 1 row). Mobile 390px: scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 → zero horizontal overflow. Staff /carta page shows digital-carta-panel with qr-code (QRCodeCanvas), digital-carta-url ending '/carta-digitale', download-qr-button triggers PNG download (qr-carta-dei-vini.png), copy-link-button, open-public-carta-button, digital-carta-status badge toggles 'Attiva'/'Disattivata'; admin-only digital-carta-toggle flips carta_pubblica_attiva — when OFF, a second (incognito) browser context on /carta-digitale shows public-carta-error 'La carta digitale non è al momento disponibile'; toggled back ON successfully. Wine visibility: created a wine via API with visibile=false → wine-hidden-badge-<id> renders text 'Nascosto ai clienti' on the staff gallery AND /api/public/carta excludes it. Printable carta regression still works (ROSSO heading + Amaranta row + 'servire a 18°' visible on /carta screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: PublicCartaPage.jsx uses axios directly (not the shared `api` instance) which is correct for anonymous fetch BUT the shared axios in /lib/api sends withCredentials; the public page's bare axios.get still produces 4 background 401 console errors (likely from a global /auth/me call made by AuthContext mounted at root). Not a functional bug (public page works) but it pollutes the browser console on a public URL seen by customers. Consider skipping /auth/me when location.pathname === '/carta-digitale'.

PublicWineSheet renders affinamento inside a second grid wrapper (`
`) which breaks visual alignment with the 2-col grid above it. Minor UX nit — looks like a stray single-column Info while all others are two columns.

server.py read_settings() does a DB round-trip on every /api/public/carta request. For a public endpoint exposed via QR code this will scale poorly on busy restaurant services; consider a tiny in-process TTL cache (e.g. 5s) or load once per request lifecycle.

server.py public_carta returns the FULL wines collection with no pagination. With a growing catalog on a mobile phone this will become slow — recommend adding a simple projection + optional cursor pagination later. Not a blocker today (collection has 1 wine).
test_credentials: admin@cartadeivini.it / Bordeaux-2026! (works). Created and cleaned up TEST_pubstaff@cartadeivini.it.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created+deleted TEST_PUB_Visible and TEST_PUB_Hidden wines + TEST_pubstaff user. Frontend tests created+deleted TEST_UI_PubHidden via API. Real customer wine 'Amaranta' (Tenuta Ulisse) untouched. carta_pubblica_attiva confirmed = true at end (verified via toggle flow + final set).
